```{=html}
<style>
  :root{
    --navy:#1C355E; --teal:#00AE8D; --teal-lt:#00C9A7;
    --coral:#E96852; --coral-lt:#FF7A5C; --purple:#625D9C; --purple-lt:#9B8EC0;
    --ink:#22303f; --muted:#6b7a8d; --paper:#f6f8fb; --card:#ffffff;
  }
  /* Hide Quarto's default title block; we render our own hero */
  header#title-block-header{ display:none; }
  body{
    background:var(--paper);
    color:var(--ink);
    font-family:"Segoe UI",-apple-system,BlinkMacSystemFont,"Helvetica Neue",Arial,sans-serif;
    margin:0;
  }
  .rr-wrap{ max-width:1100px; margin:0 auto; padding:0 1.1rem 3rem; }

  /* ---- Hero ---- */
  .rr-hero{
    text-align:center; color:#fff; border-radius:0 0 34px 34px;
    padding:2.6rem 1.2rem 2.9rem;
    background:linear-gradient(135deg,var(--navy) 0%,var(--teal) 55%,var(--coral) 100%);
    box-shadow:0 12px 30px rgba(28,53,94,.28);
  }
  .rr-hero h1{
    margin:.2rem 0 .35rem; font-size:clamp(2.2rem,6vw,3.6rem); font-weight:800;
    letter-spacing:.5px; text-shadow:0 3px 12px rgba(0,0,0,.22);
  }
  .rr-hero p{ margin:0 auto; max-width:640px; font-size:clamp(1rem,2.4vw,1.3rem); opacity:.96; }
  .rr-emoji{ font-size:clamp(2.4rem,7vw,3.6rem); line-height:1; }
  .rr-pills{ margin-top:1.1rem; display:flex; gap:.5rem; flex-wrap:wrap; justify-content:center; }
  .rr-pill{
    background:rgba(255,255,255,.18); border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.35);
    padding:.32rem .8rem; border-radius:999px; font-size:.85rem; font-weight:600; backdrop-filter:blur(2px);
  }

  /* ---- Week section ---- */
  .rr-week{ margin-top:2.4rem; }
  .rr-week-head{
    display:flex; align-items:center; gap:.7rem; color:#fff; font-weight:800;
    padding:.7rem 1.1rem; border-radius:16px; font-size:clamp(1.05rem,3vw,1.4rem);
    box-shadow:0 6px 16px rgba(28,53,94,.16);
  }
  .rr-week-head .num{
    background:rgba(255,255,255,.22); border-radius:12px; padding:.15rem .7rem; font-size:.9em;
  }
  .w-teal  { background:linear-gradient(90deg,var(--teal),var(--teal-lt)); }
  .w-coral { background:linear-gradient(90deg,var(--coral),var(--coral-lt)); }
  .w-purple{ background:linear-gradient(90deg,var(--purple),var(--purple-lt)); }

  /* ---- Card grid ---- */
  .rr-grid{
    display:grid; gap:1rem; margin-top:1rem;
    grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fill,minmax(230px,1fr));
  }
  .rr-card{
    position:relative; display:block; text-decoration:none; color:inherit;
    background:var(--card); border-radius:20px; padding:1.1rem 1.1rem 1.2rem;
    border:2px solid #e7edf4; box-shadow:0 4px 14px rgba(28,53,94,.08);
    transition:transform .16s ease, box-shadow .16s ease, border-color .16s ease;
    overflow:hidden; min-height:150px;
  }
  a.rr-card:hover{
    transform:translateY(-6px); box-shadow:0 16px 30px rgba(28,53,94,.18);
    border-color:var(--teal);
  }
  .rr-badge{
    display:inline-flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center;
    min-width:2.7rem; height:2.7rem; padding:0 .5rem; border-radius:14px;
    color:#fff; font-weight:800; font-size:1.15rem; letter-spacing:.5px;
    box-shadow:0 3px 8px rgba(0,0,0,.14);
  }
  .b-teal{ background:var(--teal); } .b-coral{ background:var(--coral); } .b-purple{ background:var(--purple); }
  .rr-card-emoji{ float:right; font-size:1.9rem; line-height:1; }
  .rr-card h3{ margin:.7rem 0 .3rem; font-size:1.16rem; font-weight:800; color:var(--navy); }
  .rr-card p{ margin:0; font-size:.9rem; color:var(--muted); line-height:1.4; }

  /* live vs coming-soon */
  .rr-play{
    margin-top:.75rem; display:inline-flex; align-items:center; gap:.35rem;
    font-weight:700; font-size:.85rem; color:var(--teal);
  }
  .rr-card.soon{ opacity:.6; border-style:dashed; }
  .rr-card.soon h3{ color:#55627a; }
  .rr-ribbon{
    margin-top:.75rem; display:inline-flex; align-items:center; gap:.35rem;
    font-weight:700; font-size:.8rem; color:#8a95a8;
    background:#eef2f7; padding:.22rem .6rem; border-radius:999px;
  }

  /* Weeks with no deck yet: one muted strip, not a grid of cards nobody can open */
  .rr-soon{
    margin:1rem .2rem 0; padding:.9rem 1.15rem; border-radius:16px;
    border:2px dashed #d9e1ea; background:#fbfcfe;
    color:var(--muted); font-size:.93rem; line-height:1.6;
  }
  .rr-soon b{ color:#55627a; font-weight:700; }
  .rr-soon .tag{
    display:inline-flex; align-items:center; gap:.3rem; margin-right:.45rem;
    font-weight:700; font-size:.78rem; color:#8a95a8; white-space:nowrap;
    background:#eef2f7; padding:.2rem .6rem; border-radius:999px;
  }

  .rr-note{
    margin:.9rem .2rem 0; font-size:.82rem; color:var(--muted); line-height:1.5;
  }
  .rr-note a{ color:var(--navy); font-weight:600; }

  .rr-foot{ text-align:center; color:var(--muted); margin-top:2.6rem; font-size:.85rem; }
  .rr-foot .star{ color:var(--coral); }

  @media (max-width:520px){
    .rr-grid{ grid-template-columns:1fr; }
  }
</style>

<div class="rr-hero">
  <div class="rr-emoji">🤖🎸</div>
  <h1>Robot Rockstars</h1>
  <p>From a box of LEGO to a competition robot in <strong>5 weeks</strong>. Follow the sessions and start building. 🚀</p>
  <div class="rr-pills">
    <span class="rr-pill">🧱 LEGO SPIKE Prime</span>
    <span class="rr-pill">🐍 Python + Pybricks</span>
    <span class="rr-pill">🏆 WRO 2026 RoboMission</span>
  </div>
</div>

<div class="rr-wrap">
  <p class="rr-note">The course has 25 sessions. Each S badge shows its place in the schedule; a session can cross a week boundary when more practice is needed.</p>

  <!-- ============ WEEK 1 ============ -->
  <section class="rr-week">
    <div class="rr-week-head w-teal"><span class="num">Week 1</span> Build, Move, Repeat 🛠️</div>
    <p class="rr-note">Sessions 1–5. Take two sessions to build, then learn movement, wheel maths, and while loops.</p>
    <div class="rr-grid">

      <a class="rr-card" href="slides/build-and-test.html">
        <span class="rr-badge b-teal">S1–2</span><span class="rr-card-emoji">🧱</span>
        <h3>Build Your Robot</h3>
        <p>Meet the WRO, tour the bench, build a rock-solid driving base, then switch it on.</p>
        <span class="rr-play">▶ Open slides</span>
      </a>

      <a class="rr-card" href="slides/make-it-move.html">
        <span class="rr-badge b-teal">S3</span><span class="rr-card-emoji">🏎️</span>
        <h3>Make It Move</h3>
        <p>Your first program. Speed = distance ÷ time, and wheel spins become real centimetres.</p>
        <span class="rr-play">▶ Open slides</span>
      </a>

      <a class="rr-card" href="slides/beam-balance.html">
        <span class="rr-badge b-teal">S4</span><span class="rr-card-emoji">⚖️</span>
        <h3>The Beam Balance</h3>
        <p>Six oranges, three bananas, and the rule that lied. Work out the degrees yourself, for any distance.</p>
        <span class="rr-play">▶ Open slides</span>
      </a>

      <a class="rr-card" href="slides/while-loops.html">
        <span class="rr-badge b-teal">S5</span><span class="rr-card-emoji">🔁</span>
        <h3>Until It's True</h3>
        <p>Step through a <code>while</code> loop line by line, hunt the colon and indent bugs, then stop a real wheel at one turn.</p>
        <span class="rr-play">▶ Open slides</span>
      </a>

    </div>
  </section>

  <!-- ============ WEEK 2 ============ -->
  <section class="rr-week">
    <div class="rr-week-head w-coral"><span class="num">Week 2</span> Turns, Functions, Control 🧭</div>
    <p class="rr-note">Sessions 6–10. Give function writing its own practice session before adding P control and the motion library.</p>
    <div class="rr-grid">

      <a class="rr-card" href="slides/drive-a-square.html">
        <span class="rr-badge b-coral">S6</span><span class="rr-card-emoji">⬛</span>
        <h3>Drive a Square</h3>
        <p>Loops that repeat, plus and minus on the gyro, and why a watched turn still lands at 94.</p>
        <span class="rr-play">▶ Open slides</span>
      </a>

      <a class="rr-card" href="slides/cure-the-coast.html">
        <span class="rr-badge b-coral">S7</span><span class="rr-card-emoji">🩹</span>
        <h3>Cure the Coast</h3>
        <p>Arrive slowly to beat momentum, and wrap the cure in your first <code>def</code>.</p>
        <span class="rr-play">▶ Open slides</span>
      </a>

      <a class="rr-card" href="slides/write-it-yourself.html">
        <span class="rr-badge b-coral">S8</span><span class="rr-card-emoji">⌨️</span>
        <h3>Write It Yourself</h3>
        <p>Nothing new: three fresh problems, three <code>def</code>s you write on your own.</p>
        <span class="rr-play">▶ Open slides</span>
      </a>

      <a class="rr-card" href="slides/pid-on-the-gyro.html">
        <span class="rr-badge b-coral">S9</span><span class="rr-card-emoji">🧭</span>
        <h3>The Drive That Heals Itself</h3>
        <p>Race your own turn, then give the cure a brain: the P-term, on turns and on the straight.</p>
        <span class="rr-play">▶ Open slides</span>
      </a>

      <a class="rr-card" href="slides/name-your-moves.html">
        <span class="rr-badge b-coral">S10</span><span class="rr-card-emoji">📦</span>
        <h3>Name Your Moves</h3>
        <p>Add derivative braking, build your move library, and win Bullseye with code <em>you</em> wrote.</p>
        <span class="rr-play">▶ Open slides</span>
      </a>

    </div>
  </section>

  <!-- ============ WEEK 3 ============ -->
  <section class="rr-week">
    <div class="rr-week-head w-purple"><span class="num">Week 3</span> Sense, Consolidate, Build 🧰</div>
    <p class="rr-note">Sessions 11–15. Use the sensors, consolidate your library, form teams, and build a working mechanism.</p>
    <div class="rr-grid">

      <a class="rr-card" href="slides/pd-line-following.html">
        <span class="rr-badge b-purple">S11</span><span class="rr-card-emoji">🛣️</span>
        <h3>Line King</h3>
        <p>Read the line, choose with <code>elif</code>, ride the edge with P, then square up with <code>not</code> and <code>and</code>.</p>
        <span class="rr-play">▶ Open slides</span>
      </a>

      <a class="rr-card" href="slides/stop-patrol-react.html">
        <span class="rr-badge b-purple">S12</span><span class="rr-card-emoji">🚦</span>
        <h3>Stop at the Wall</h3>
        <p>Use a motor as a sensor, back off on a bump, and patrol wall to wall.</p>
        <span class="rr-play">▶ Open slides</span>
      </a>

      <a class="rr-card" href="slides/drivebase-shortcut.html">
        <span class="rr-badge b-purple">S13</span><span class="rr-card-emoji">🧰</span>
        <h3>The Earned Shortcut</h3>
        <p>Put your robot's measured facts in one place, move your driving library onto <code>DriveBase</code>, then run the Gauntlet.</p>
        <span class="rr-play">▶ Open slides</span>
      </a>

      <a class="rr-card" href="slides/draft-day.html">
        <span class="rr-badge b-purple">S14</span><span class="rr-card-emoji">🤝</span>
        <h3>Draft Day</h3>
        <p>The last solo showdown, then teams form and the first mechanism build begins.</p>
        <span class="rr-play">▶ Open slides</span>
      </a>

      <a class="rr-card" href="slides/gears.html">
        <span class="rr-badge b-purple">S15</span><span class="rr-card-emoji">⚙️</span>
        <h3>Gears</h3>
        <p>Explore gear direction, ratio, and the trade-off between speed and torque.</p>
        <span class="rr-play">▶ Open slides</span>
      </a>

    </div>
  </section>

  <!-- ============ WEEK 4 ============ -->
  <section class="rr-week">
    <div class="rr-week-head w-teal"><span class="num">Week 4</span> Program the Mechanism, Chain the Run ⛓️</div>
    <p class="rr-note">Sessions 16–20. Program your mechanism, test each task, and join the calls into a complete run.</p>
    <div class="rr-grid">

      <a class="rr-card" href="slides/programming-the-claw.html">
        <span class="rr-badge b-teal">S16</span><span class="rr-card-emoji">🦾</span>
        <h3>Programming the Claw</h3>
        <p>Explore motor targets, find home, and build <code>home()</code>, <code>grab()</code>, and <code>release()</code>.</p>
        <span class="rr-play">▶ Open the interactive lesson</span>
      </a>

    </div>
    <p class="rr-soon"><span class="tag">🔒 Coming soon</span><b>Bench and integration sessions (S17–S20):</b> finish and test each mechanism, choose the team robot, plan the first route, and chain cables, microphone, instruments, and avoidance into the ~135-point anchor. Write movement and gripper calls in order, using named task functions when useful. Start a five-run log as soon as tasks are chained.</p>
  </section>

  <!-- ============ WEEK 5 ============ -->
  <section class="rr-week">
    <div class="rr-week-head w-coral"><span class="num">Week 5</span> Make It Reliable, Then Compete 🏆</div>
    <p class="rr-note">Sessions 21–25. Use your run log to improve the robot, test changed conditions, and prepare for the mock qualifier.</p>
    <p class="rr-soon"><span class="tag">🔒 Coming soon</span><b>Reliability and handoff (S21–S25):</b> tune from logged failures, test different starts and lighting, finish the Technical Summary, and run the mock qualifier. The final gate is the <b>~135-point anchor succeeding in at least 18 of 20 runs</b>. Fixed notes are an optional extension after that gate. Randomized notes and the full-255 programme belong to the continuation season.</p>
  </section>

  <!-- ============ REFERENCE & PRACTICE ============ -->
  <section class="rr-week">
    <div class="rr-week-head w-teal"><span class="num">Reference</span> Keep These Open 📄</div>
    <div class="rr-grid">

      <a class="rr-card" href="library-cheatsheet.html">
        <span class="rr-badge b-teal">S10+</span><span class="rr-card-emoji">📄</span>
        <h3>Library Cheat Sheet</h3>
        <p>Every verb you own on one page. The gripper half fills in once you build one. Keep it open on the bench.</p>
        <span class="rr-play">▶ Open the cheat sheet</span>
      </a>

      <a class="rr-card" href="interactives/recap-part1-days2-5.html">
        <span class="rr-badge b-teal">S3–S10</span><span class="rr-card-emoji">🕹️</span>
        <h3>Recap Arcade · Part 1</h3>
        <p>Movement, loops, functions, and control as short levels: watch the demo, answer one question. Ends with a miss list to bring to the coach.</p>
        <span class="rr-play">▶ Play the recap</span>
      </a>

      <a class="rr-card" href="interactives/recap-part2-days5-8.html">
        <span class="rr-badge b-coral">S10–S13</span><span class="rr-card-emoji">🕹️</span>
        <h3>Recap Arcade · Part 2</h3>
        <p>Six more levels: where a room lives, the eye, the line, two eyes, the wall, the library. Demo first, question last, miss list at the end.</p>
        <span class="rr-play">▶ Play the recap</span>
      </a>

    </div>
  </section>

  <!-- ============ TOOLBOX ============ -->
  <section class="rr-week">
    <div class="rr-week-head w-purple"><span class="num">Toolbox</span> Measure the Field 📐</div>
    <div class="rr-grid">

      <a class="rr-card" href="tools/odommap/OdomMap.html">
        <span class="rr-badge b-purple">🗺️</span><span class="rr-card-emoji">📐</span>
        <h3>OdomMap</h3>
        <p>Click two points on the real mat to read the distance in mm and the wheel rotations to drive it. Set <strong>Wheel = 88 mm</strong>, pick <em>2026 / Elementary</em>. Use it when planning and testing your route.</p>
        <span class="rr-play">▶ Open the tool</span>
      </a>

    </div>
    <p class="rr-note">
      OdomMap is vendored from
      <a href="https://github.com/haing2811/OdomMap" target="_blank" rel="noopener">haing2811/OdomMap</a>

      Only the 2026 Elementary mat is bundled here; other years show a missing image.
    </p>
  </section>

  <div class="rr-foot">
    Made for Robot Rockstars <span class="star">★</span> WRO 2026 RoboMission Elementary
  </div>

</div>
```
